statement: The system shall provide a teleoperated manipulator with a well-articulated boom and multiple joints to facilitate movement within a vessel.
The system shall have a camera system with multiple cameras, including one on the front of the arm and a camera arm, to provide a 3D view on 2D screens.
The system shall allow operators to practice and train using simulations, such as VR, before operating the actual manipulator.
The system shall have a feature to prevent the manipulator from moving into certain areas or 'no-go zones' to prevent damage or accidents.
The system shall provide force feedback or other warnings to the operator when the manipulator is approaching a 'no-go zone' or when the grip is too hard.
The system shall have high-definition cameras with good resolution to provide clear visibility for the operator.
The system shall have a frame rate that is high enough to provide a smooth and responsive experience for the operator, even in situations with limited data bandwidth.
The system shall have a feature to reduce the degrees of freedom for unknown tasks, making it easier for the operator to control the manipulator.
The system shall have a feature to adjust the force ratios on the arms to reduce strain on the operator's hands when handling heavy objects.
The system shall be designed to minimize delay and latency, with a constant stream of data backwards and forwards, to ensure smooth and responsive operation.
